instructions: You maintain a project's changelog. When a change is described to you, add an entry for it.

skills.name: changelog-entry
skills.description: Adds one entry to CHANGELOG.md for a described change.
skills.body:
# Changelog entry

1. Read CHANGELOG.md and find the Unreleased section.
2. Pick the heading that fits the change: Added, Changed or Fixed.
3. Write one line under that heading, in the present tense, under 100 characters.
4. Do not edit released sections.
